children: The chance of a further interest-rate rise by the Reserve Bank of Australia in November is considerably higher than priced, says Ivan Colhoun, economist at Marex. Colhoun says he is reverting to making a fifth hike next month his base case forecast. The change of view follows hawkish comments by RBA Deputy Gov. Andrew Hauser to a markets conference Wednesday, he adds. Hauser said the inflation outlook looks "materially worse" than projected in August. The use of the word materially suggests that the interest-rate rise in September is unlikely to be sufficient, Colhoun adds. (james.glynn@wsj.com; @JamesGlynnWSJ)
